t: # Short Obligatory Prayer ## To be recited once in twenty-four hours, at noon. O! Me Onyankopɔn; megyi adanse sɛ Wo ɔbɔ me sɛ me bɛbɛ hu Wo ne me si Wo. Megyi adanse kaake mɔ sɛ me mmɛ ayule akoa ne wole Wo de ayule mmɔodahwɛ. Megyi ehia buburo ne woleɛ Wo de sika mmɔodahwɛ. Onyankopɔn akoa bɛtɛ ka Wo so. Wo ne Wo hu ɛne mmɔbɔ bo ɛne amanehunu tɛ. Wo ne Wo ɛfɛ yi Wo yo so.
